races.paceDynamic: In The Post is the sole confirmed leader with no obvious challenger for the early initiative, setting up a controlled pace scenario over this stamina-testing trip. Piecederesistance may sit prominent but prefers to track rather than dispute the lead, while the remaining five runners are all hold-up types who will settle towards the rear. This creates a tactical race where In The Post can dictate terms without pressure, potentially building an unassailable advantage before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. The abundance of hold-up runners fighting for late room strongly favours the early-positioned horses who can secure clear runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If In The Post gets an easy lead and maintains stamina over the extended trip
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old can control sectionals without early pressure and kick clear before the hold-up brigade organize their challenges. His moderate recent handicap form becomes less relevant when granted tactical supremacy in a race full of horses needing luck in running.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses bunch up turning for home and struggle for racing room
scenarios.body: The six hold-up runners create a scramble for gaps while In The Post maintains his advantage, with only those finding clear runs able to threaten. This scenario rewards the horses with the best pilot judgment and positioning skills.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Two Pull Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Piecederesistance presses In The Post and they establish a decisive break
scenarios.body: The two early-positioned horses work together to create unsustainable sectionals for the hold-up horses over this demanding distance. Piecederesistance's recent front-running third at Pontefract suggests renewed vigor under his new connections.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Time Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up runners all find racing room and the early pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The patient tactics finally pay dividends when In The Post weakens dramatically and the closers find clear passages simultaneously. This requires perfect race conditions and strong stamina from the back markers.

races.paceDynamic: Lorna B is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will have an uncontested lead early on. Men Of Honour, HK Fourteen and Cairdeas will sit prominent but none are aggressive pace-setters, creating a moderate gallop rather than genuine pressure. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Coachello, Lord Bertie, Novello Lad, Supreme King, Gallant, Havana Rum, Wreck It Ryley, Noble Consort) will be bunched up behind a steady pace over this straight 6f at Doncaster. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who will get the perfectly judged gallop they need to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lorna B sets only a moderate pace and the prominent runners fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses gets an ideal setup with plenty of room to manoeuvre and finishing kick intact. Class horses like Noble Consort and Novello Lad can time their runs perfectly in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Lorna B gets away with very soft fractions and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: With no genuine pace pressure applied, Lorna B maintains enough in reserve to hold off late challenges despite her 8-month absence. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the straight track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Men Of Honour or Cairdeas travel strongly and kick clear before the hold-up horses wind up
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field while positioned perfectly to respond to Lorna B's modest gallop. They establish a decisive advantage before the back markers can close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is exceptionally slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure dash from the 2f pole with little pattern or rhythm. Any horse with natural gate speed or tactical pace can prevail regardless of usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Lorna B must handle 252 days off as the only pace angle and any fitness issues would gift the race to closers
Noble Consort returning from 8 months off after rapid progress but visor back on suggests confidence
HK Fourteen steps up from usual 5f trip without cheekpieces that aided recent improvement
Men Of Honour and Cairdeas both face long absences as the main prominent threats to a soft pace
Watch for any market support for Lord Bertie despite ground concerns as O'Meara stable runs well fresh

races.paceDynamic: Watchdog is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely getting an uncontested lead in the opening stages. Behind him, Orange Emperor, Milford Grange, Believeinmenow and Black Endeavour all want prominent positions, creating a congested pack 2-3 lengths off the leader with potential traffic problems developing 2-3 furlongs out. The strong contingent of hold-up horses (Concert, Slot, Uncertainty, Wise Crack, Coyy) will be relying on gaps appearing in the straight as the prominent pack comes under pressure. This race shape heavily favours front-runners and those who can secure an early position, as the hold-up brigade face a significant disadvantage with limited pace pressure on the leader and inevitable traffic issues.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Watchdog Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Watchdog secures an easy early lead without pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The leader will have too much in reserve for the closing kick, while the bunched prominent horses create a wall that traps the hold-up runners. Watchdog's proven ability to make all on this course/distance combination becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent horses bunch up and interfere with each other 2f out
scenarios.body: The pace collapses into a messy sprint where whoever finds the clearest passage wins, while multiple hold-up horses get trapped behind the melee. Early position becomes everything in a stop-start finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero
scenarios.trigger: If gaps miraculously appear and one of the closers gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: A horse like Concert or Coyy with proven finishing speed can capitalise on the expected pace collapse, but they need serious luck in running. The race sets up poorly for this group but class can prevail.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Orange Emperor or Believeinmenow press Watchdog from the start creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The early speed duel sets up a closers' finish where the hold-up horses can finally utilise their running style advantage. The front rank comes back to the field in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a pile-up 2-3 furlongs out as Orange Emperor, Milford Grange, Believeinmenow and Black Endeavour all converge behind Watchdog
Monitor if Watchdog gets an uncontested lead through the first half-mile, making him very hard to peg back
Observe whether Concert or Coyy can secure racing room down the outside when the prominent group comes under pressure
Check if Orange Emperor's pulling tendencies resurface early, potentially disrupting the prominent group's positioning
Watch for Believeinmenow to be produced with a late run if the early pace is genuine enough to bring her into contention

races.paceDynamic: Masaban and Ice Cube will set the early fractions from the front, with both having shown pace-forcing tendencies and likely to engage early. The prominent runners High Chieftain, Irish Incentive, Smartanck, Mayflower Billy and Gloriola will track just behind this early battle. With 16 runners and two committed leaders, this creates an honest gallop that should set up well for the closers. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish late, particularly those drawn well to get cover and make their moves when the early pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Masaban and Ice Cube engage in a sustained duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The honest gallop stretches the field and creates perfect conditions for the hold-up merchants to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Horses like Tarmonbarry Kid, Crimson Sunset, Palace Artois and Red Rifle get the tactical scenario they need.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Gallop Setup
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easier time up front while the other is restrained
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more tactical allowing prominent runners to stay closer and finish stronger. This brings Irish Incentive and High Chieftain into stronger contention alongside the pacesetting Ice Cube.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Early Fractions
scenarios.trigger: If both Masaban and Ice Cube are taken back early creating a falsely-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where the prominent runners and those with tactical speed hold sway. Mayflower Billy's tendency to fade becomes less relevant in a sprint scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the two main pace angles fail to materialise due to tactics or travel problems
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly slow pace allows all running styles to remain competitive turning this into a cavalry charge finish. The race becomes a lottery with any horse capable of winning from any position.

races.paceDynamic: Dion Baker is the only confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner handicap and will face no pressure for the early lead, allowing him to dictate terms at a sustainable gallop. The majority of runners are hold-up types including Moonhall Lass, Typeface, and Fifty Sent, with prominent racers like Heretic, Bullington Bry and Shark Two One likely to settle just behind the leader. With so many hold-up horses needing room and luck in running, the uncontested leader and those tracking close behind will have a significant tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Dion Baker maintains his steady gallop and kicks clear in the straight
scenarios.body: The front-runner will have every chance to control the race from pillar to post while the large pack of hold-up horses struggle for room behind. Baker's 7f turf wins and light weight make him perfectly placed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the horses tracking the leader gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: The pace-setter will soften up the ground for a well-positioned prominent racer to pounce, with the hold-up brigade still needing luck. Moonhall Lass has winning form and can track into contention from her hold-up style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and the hold-up horses get a clear run
scenarios.body: A slow early gallop would neutralize the front-runner's advantage and allow the closers to mount their preferred finishing kick. Typeface has the class edge with his Ffos Las win and strong turf record.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If other horses challenge Dion Baker for the early lead
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle would set up the race for late closers, though no other obvious leaders are apparent in the field. This scenario depends on tactical changes from the prominent runners.

races.paceDynamic: Lion Ring is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner handicap and will set his own fractions unopposed through the early stages. On Key and Diligent Henry may press from prominent positions, but neither is keen enough to challenge Lion Ring for the lead. With no sustained pace pressure expected, Lion Ring can dictate comfortable sectionals before the field closes in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Soft Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring sets pedestrian fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace will set up a sprint finish where closers with tactical speed can unleash devastating late runs. Hold-up horses like War Memorial and Melissa Honey can time their challenges perfectly from off the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If On Key or Diligent Henry track Lion Ring closely and kick turning in
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can get first run on the field while the hold-up horses are still finding their stride. On Key's recent consistency at Southwell gives him the edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring's soft lead allows him to retain enough energy for the finish
scenarios.body: The veteran can use his uncontested advantage to build an unassailable lead before the closers can respond. His recent Wolverhampton wins prove he has the class when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses launch simultaneous challenges in a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The compressed field creates traffic problems and luck in running becomes crucial for the back-markers. Fresher horses with experienced jockeys gain vital advantages in the melee.
